name: Haven Bound (Story)
description: You woke to the shelter radio hissing the same loop: 'Haven is lit. The light stays on. Bring what you can carry.' Outside lies a dead courier with a Haven chit stamped with NEXT MONTH'S date. Someone out east is alive, organized, and expecting people. Your endgoal: cross the wastes and REACH HAVEN. Survive the first day, then find people and ask for work - the road east starts with water, trust, and a working radio tower.
